ipeds.title: IPEDS Admissions survey, fall 2023 entering class (ADM2023); College Navigator also shows fall 2024

ipeds_ef.title: IPEDS Fall Enrollment 2023 (EF2023A): undergraduate total and U.S. nonresident headcount

stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS (fall 2023 entering class); no recent Common Data Set is published (ETSU's CDS page lists only 2004-05 through 2010-11). College Navigator's fall 2024 figures: 10,050 applicants, 86% admitted, 25% of admits enrolled; SAT 7% and ACT 76% of enrollees; middle-50% SAT EBRW 510-620, SAT Math 470-580, ACT composite 19-26. International applicant and admit counts, GPA and residency splits are not available. 10,829 undergraduates is the fall 2024 College Navigator count; the international undergraduate count is left blank (ETSU says nearly 350 international students of all levels, from 60+ countries).
